From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Subject: Vendor portal inventory deep dive & evidence transition plan

Hi Daniel — and hi Marissa/Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. As we prepare Trident for Redwood's SIG/CAIQ mapping and a short SOC 2 reconciliation, can you run a consolidated export of the current vendor portal inventory (profiles, attachments, field-level ownership) across Whistic and Vendr? The goal is to produce a single CSV we can use to: 

- map SIG questions to each profile 
- flag artifacts that are SOC 2-relevant (system configs, policies, certs) 
- identify who at Trident is the owner for each evidence item and whether it can be presigned/downloaded

If possible include these columns in the export: profile_id, portal (Whistic|Vendr), attached_filename, attachment_type, uploaded_at, owner_name, owner_email, visibility (public/internal), presign_allowed (yes/no).

We'll need a snapshot by EOW (Friday) to hit our internal evidence rotation window. Proposed next step: 30-min deep dive today or tomorrow to review a sample export and agree on ownership transfer semantics (we typically ask vendors to grant a short-lived presign link for evidence we ingest).

Also flag any artifacts that are under NDA or that cannot be exported — we can handle those separately with a POA.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. We can generate that export. I've attached a quick snapshot (trident_inventory_snapshot_20281121.csv) and a short note about a couple of edge cases we found while pulling it: 

- A set of older SOC artifacts (2019–2021) are archived and marked "no-export" in Whistic due to contractual retention rules.
- Vendr stores some large binary attachments (DB backups) as links to an S3 bucket we control; we can provide presign URLs for individual objects but not a bulk presign export.

Available for a 30-min sync at 1:30pm or 3:00pm PT today. I included the security team in cc for the presign discussion.

Thanks Daniel — received. I pulled the CSV and did a quick pass. High-level plan below; I'll own coordination with Trident for any SOC-2-scoped artifacts.

High-level plan / owners:
- Inventory normalization (Priyom) — canonicalize portal field names and produce a manifest we can ingest into our evidence tracker. Deliverable: normalized_manifest.csv by Thu EOD.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping (Mina) — tag each profile with the relevant SIG controls and flag missing answers or missing attachments. Deliverable: sig_map_v0.3.xlsx (working).
- SOC 2 artifact verification (Marissa) — review owner assertions and request presigned links or ephemeral access for items we need to copy into our evidence bucket.

Specific asks for Daniel/security: 
- For S3-hosted attachments, we'll need either a presign window (recommended 72 hours) or a mechanical export of the object. If presigns are not possible, please indicate retention window and whether we can request one-off presigns.
- For anything marked "no-export", please point us to the contractual clause or provide a contact who can approve exception requests.

I've started the sig_map_v0.3.xlsx and uploaded a working copy to the drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeF-inventory-plan (link). Priyom — can you schedule a 30-min working session with Daniel for 3:00pm PT today? If Daniel prefers 1:30pm, that works too.

Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0222

- Daniel / Trident security: provide presign capability for S3 links where possible (recommended 72-hour TTL) or approve a path to request one-off presigns. If there are contract restrictions, send the reference clause or point person.
